Firefox products are designed to protect your privacy

Learn more about Firefox browsers and products that handle your data with respect and are built for privacy anywhere you go online.

Learn more about Firefox, its history, features and mission

Find your best browser for speed, privacy and security.

So many browser options, but there's only one that works best for your needs. The best browser for you should offer both speed and privacy protection.

Firefox FAQ

Whether you searched for a fast browser that protects your privacy, this FAQ is here to answer the most pressing Firefox-related questions.

Update your browser to fast, safe and secure Firefox.

The Firefox browser is built to protect your privacy at every turn — because that's the fastest way to free you from slow loads, bad ads, and trackers.

Incognito browser: What it really means

Firefox calls it private browsing, Chrome calls it incognito mode. Both let you browse the web without saving your browsing history.

Browser History: Epic power struggles that brought us modern browsers

The browser wars, underdogs vs giants, and moments that changed the world. Read about the history of the web browser.

What is a web browser?

A web browser takes you anywhere on the internet, letting you see text, images and video from anywhere in the world.

Firefox for Windows 64-bit

Users on 64-bit Windows who download Firefox can get our 64-bit version by default. That means you get a more secure version of Firefox.

خيارات التنزيل واللغات الأخرى
دعم Firefox Browser

أحدث ميزات Firefox

  • امنح نفسك لحظة من الهدوء

    احظر الإعلانات وعزّز خصوصيتك من خلال إعدادات قابلة للتخصيص والعديد من الإضافات القابلة للتنزيل.

  • تعدّد المهام؟

    انتقل إلى وضع القراءة وافتح مقاطع الفيديو في نوافذ منبثقة، ونظّم تجربتك بشكل أفضل من خلال علامات التبويب العمودية ومجموعات علامات التبويب.

  • تابع جميع علامات التبويب

    أغلق المكرّر منها، وابحث، وثبّت علامات التبويب المفتوحة — هناك إمكانيات لا حصر لها لإدارة العدد شبه اللانهائي من علامات التبويب المفتوحة.

انظر ملاحظات الإصدار

حمّل المتصفح الذي يساعدك على إنجاز المهام

احظر مُتعقّبات الإعلانات دون أي مجهود

تتسبّب مُتعقّبات الإعلانات في بطء تحميل صفحات الويب. لكن مع Firefox، لن تحتاج إلى البحث في الإعدادات لإيقافها فنحن نحظر مُعظم المتعقّبات تلقائيًا.

وداعًا للمشتّتات

حافظ على تركيزك مع إضافات مثل Tomato Clock و Turn Off the Lights — وهي ضمن قائمة "الموصى بها"، أي أنها حصلت على علامة التميّز لدينا بفضل الأمان الفائق والأداء المميز.

كل ما يخصك، على جميع شاشاتك.

حمّل Firefox على هاتفك لتأخذ معك كلمات المرور وعلامات التبويب وسجل التصفح — إلى جانب الخصوصية والأمان اللذين تعتمد عليهما — أينما ذهبت.

الخصوصية مُدمجة

بياناتك الشخصية ليست للبيع. نحجب المُتعقّبات وملفات تعريف الارتباط من الأطراف الثالثة افتراضيًا، لتستمتع بتجربة تصفح آمنة وسلسة.

اكتشف كيف تحمي Firefox بياناتك.

صمّمها بالطريقة التي تُناسبك *حقًا*

  • أنجز مهامك بذكاء، واستمتع بلا حدود.

    اكتشف إمكانيات جديدة للبحث والتسوّق وغير ذلك من خلال الإضافات.

  • وداعًا للمتصفحات المملة

    يُمكن أن يكون الإنترنت مكانًا جميلاً مع الإضافة المناسبة.

من دون أصحاب المليارات منذ أكثر من 20 عامًا

تم إنشاء Firefox في عام 2004 على يد Mozilla كبديل أسرع وأكثر خصوصية وقابلية للتخصيص مقارنة بمتصفحات مثل Internet Explorer. واليوم، ما زلنا مؤسسة غير ربحية، ولسنا مملوكين لأي ملياردير، وما زلنا نعمل على تحسين الإنترنت — وتحسين الوقت الذي تقضيه — فيه.

Cookie settings

Cookies are small files containing pieces of information that are saved to your computer or device when you visit a website. Mozilla uses Cookies to help make our websites work, as well as to collect information on how you use and interact with our websites, such as the pages you visit.

This page describes the different types of Cookies and similar technologies such as pixel tags, web beacons, clear GIFs, JavaScript, and local storage (hereafter, “Cookies”) that Mozilla may use, and gives you control over which types of data you agree to Mozilla collecting.

How Mozilla uses Cookies

  • Necessary

    What are Necessary Cookies?

    These technologies are required to support essential website features, such as logging into a secure area of a website or adding items to an online shopping basket, and cannot be turned off.

    How does Mozilla use this data?

    Mozilla uses Necessary Cookies only to provide essential website features, such as logging in using your Mozilla account or purchasing a software subscription at checkout. Without these technologies, essential website features may not function.

  • Preference

    What are Preference Cookies?

    These technologies are used to remember choices you have made during a previous visit to a website. Examples might include which language you prefer reading in, or which color theme is your favorite.

    How does Mozilla use this data?

    Mozilla uses Preference Cookies to honor your preferences and improve your experience when visiting our websites. They are not used for analytics purposes. Preference Cookies support features in a similar way to Necessary Cookies, however a website can still operate without them. As such, you can choose to opt out of their use.

  • Analytics

    What are Analytics Cookies?

    These technologies collect information about how people use websites, such as pages visited, links clicked on, and which other websites visits originated from.

    How does Mozilla use this data?

    Mozilla uses analytics information to understand how users interact with our websites so that we can improve them, and fix any problems that arise. We may also use data from Cookies, device information, and IP addresses to help us understand how users engage with our products, services, communications, websites, online campaigns, devices, and other platforms. We will only collect analytics information and set Analytics Cookies with your consent.

Your Cookie settings have been updated.

Our privacy notice

For more detailed information about the different types of information that Mozilla collects when you visit our websites, you can find a link to our privacy notice below.

Browse with features that put you first

Most browsers were built to capture your attention and monetize your data. Firefox was built to give you control.

Protection

Total cookie protection

Cookies can’t follow you across sites. What you do on one website stays there, so you’re not tracked around the internet without your consent.
Learn more

Control

Choose your AI tools

Access multiple AI chatbots from one place, without being locked into a single provider or ecosystem. Use what you want, or don’t use them at all.
Learn more

Focus

Tab Groups

Organize your open tabs by project, mood, or task so you can find what you need without the scroll of shame.
Learn more

Made by people on the internet, for people on the internet

We're here to give you the internet on your terms: fast, private and actually useful.

Protection without the hassle

Staying safe online shouldn’t demand constant attention. Firefox blocks trackers automatically and protects your privacy by default, so you can browse confidently without becoming a privacy expert.

Protection in Firefox

Control without complexity

Firefox gives you real choices without burying you in settings. Choose your tools, customize your experience, and decide how your browser works, instead of adapting to someone else’s defaults.

Control in Firefox

Focus without the fight

Your browser shouldn’t compete for your attention. Firefox is designed to reduce noise, cut distractions, and help you stay oriented, whether you’re reading, researching, or multitasking.

Learn more Made by people on the internet, for people on the internet We're here to give you the internet on your terms: fast, private and actually useful. Protection without the hassle Staying safe online shouldn’t demand constant attention. Firefox blocks trackers automatically and protects your privacy by default, so you can browse confidently without becoming a privacy expert. Protection in Firefox Control without complexity Firefox gives you real choices without burying you in settings. Choose your tools, customize your experience, and decide how your browser works, instead of adapting to someone else’s defaults. Control in Firefox Focus without the fight Your browser shouldn’t compete for your attention. Firefox is designed to reduce noise, cut distractions, and help you stay oriented, whether you’re reading, researching, or multitasking.
